notes.title: Hotfix Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!  

We would like to thank you all for the valuable feedback you’ve shared with us. Based on your input, we’ve implemented several improvements to the game. Check out the latest updates below:  

### **Fixes and Improvements**  

- **Menu Adjustments**: Various game menus have been corrected and improved. Additional updates will be made over time.  

- **Enemy AI**: We’ve enhanced the enemies’ artificial intelligence. They are now more aggressive and better at handling obstacles on the map.  

- **Revamped Bosses**:  
  - Bosses now feature new attack sprites.  
  - Each boss has been given its own unique theme music.  
  - The arenas have been redesigned to provide more dynamic and engaging battles.  

- **Sprite Improvements**: Some sprites have been refined with adjustments to their design and outlines for better visuals.  

- **Dialogue UI**: The dialogue interface has been revamped to improve accessibility and enhance the player experience.  

- **Pause Menu**: The pause menu has been redesigned for better clarity in displaying game controls.
  
- **Bug Fixes**: Several minor bugs have been resolved to ensure smoother gameplay.

We are continuously working to bring even more improvements to the game. We hope you enjoy the updates and continue to follow us on this journey!  

Thank you for your support,  
**Silent Dream Games**
